---

### Step 2: Generate an "App Password"

> [!TIP]
> Never use your primary email password. Modern email providers use dedicated **App Passwords** for third-party scripts.

* **For Gmail:**
  1. Go to your [Google Account Security](https://myaccount.google.com/security).
  2. Make sure 2-Step Verification is ON.
  3. Search for **"App Passwords"** (or go to [myaccount.google.com/apppasswords](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords)).
